figurative_meaning_bn: সব ভালোর মধ্যে কোন একটি মন্দ
figurative_meaning_en: One bad thing among many good things
similar_in_english: A rotten apple in the barrel
example_sentences_in_bangla: আমাদের পরিবারে একটা পচা আদা আছে, সবসময় ঝগড়া করে।
দলে এই পচা আলু থাকলে কাজ সব ভেস্তে যাবে।
example_sentences_in_english: There's a rotten apple in our family who always causes trouble.
If that bad apple stays in the team, everything will fall apart.
history: This idiom draws from everyday rural life in Bengal where vegetables like ginger, potatoes, pumpkins, and eggs are common staples, and a single spoiled item can affect the whole batch in markets or homes.
note: Variants use different perishable items to convey the same idea of a single corrupting element.
